title: Unlabeled exterior relation sign repair from repeated fields
primary: At flip50, pairwise-sign repair32 must have paired-seed sign-accuracy gain lower 95% bound >0 against both no-exterior (gate0) and batch-LOO gate32. At intact, repair32 versus full messages must have lower 95% bound > -0.005. All three required.
repair_rule: For each observed-observed graph edge, replace its sign by sign of zero-mean sample covariance from K independent unlabeled fields; preserve edge magnitude. Query-incident edges are not repaired and remain trusted/correct in Stage55.
scope: Known zero-mean Gaussian family; calibration fields are extra unlabeled data and not free. No query truth, corruption label or true covariance enters repair. Relation magnitudes and graph support are assumed known; only signs may be wrong.
statistics: Average over family/noise within each seed, then paired Student-t interval across 10 seed blocks. Calibration sizes other than 32 are exploratory.
